description: Look up a Legal Entity Identifier from GLEIF: by 20-character LEI, or search by company name for up to 10 matches. Legal name, other names, entity status, category, jurisdiction, company register ID, legal and headquarters address, LEI registration status, issue, renewal and corroboration. Source: GLEIF (CC0). Use for KYB, counterparty checks, trade reporting and matching companies across systems. Example: lei=HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

limit.description: Matches for a name search (1-10, default 5)

name.description: Company name to search, instead of lei
